title.zh: Major Bitcoin Core update changes default wallet protocols, risking temporary disruption across popular apps
title.en: Major Bitcoin Core update changes default wallet protocols, risking temporary disruption across popular apps

current_state.zh: Bitcoin Core v32.0rc1 defaults four RPCs to PSBTv2 and changes fee estimation behavior, creating a concentrated compatibility testing window for node operators, wallet providers, and services ahead of the planned Oct. 10 final release.
